prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Lanterns Underroot hand-painted illustrated 2D side-scrolling game sprite art. Muted blue-gray stone, moss green, warm wood/soil and restrained amber/cyan magical accents. Crisp readable full silhouettes and soft painterly local material shading; not pixel art, photoreal or 3D. ONE SQUARE transparent PNG atlas in EXACTLY TWO EQUAL COLUMNS and TWO EQUAL ROWS, four equal square cells. Each cell contains one complete named object/state with generous transparent margin at least12% on every side. Fixed side-on orthographic game camera, no floor, perspective groundplane, scenery, characters, UI, arrows, labels, text, gridlines, shadows, border, glow cloud or vignette. Genuine alpha-zero outside solid objects and tightly bounded requested local light. Don't let artwork cross a cell boundary. Consistent scale, alignment, base level, object geometry and pivot between states. Thorn hazard: dense dark woody bramble with clearly dangerous pale sharp thorns and sparse muted leaves, no flowers. Four separate modules reading order upper-left left end cap, upper-right repeatable middle bramble segment, lower-left right end cap, lower-right compact isolated bramble clump. Each has low nearly horizontal root/base and sharp upward/outward thorns, single depth plane. Consistent horizontal ground anchor at75%cellheight. Left/middle/right modules can be arranged into a longer low obstacle after export; no rectangular soil base, platforms, pots or arching scenery. The silhouette must read as hazardous, with clear full thorn tips and no gore.
